title: Same Total, Two Weeks Running
body: The map's road crossing is drawn in red, no reason noted. The clipboard's order is stamped received with no issuing signature, its headcount column carrying the same total copied from a crop-inspection tally two weeks running.
rival_reading: A crop-inspection office could keep exactly this kind of running tally and reuse last week's total when nothing changed; an unsigned order and a red-marked road do not by themselves show a response failed.
gloss: An unsigned order copies a headcount total from a crop-inspection tally two weeks running.

title: Ration Total Beside A Closure Schedule
body: The road-closure schedule fills half the page, a water ration total scrawled beside it in the same rushed hand. The bottle underneath still carries an old handling-with-gloves sticker, half peeled, with 'reuse once clean' penciled below.
rival_reading: A relief desk could log a water ration beside its own closure schedule in one sitting, and an old warning sticker on a reused bottle is common surplus; neither shows a program malfunctioned.
gloss: A water ration total shares a page with a road-closure schedule and a relabeled warning-sticker bottle.
